The dashed reference line sits at about 95.7%. Since the readings are whole numbers, each value is either 95 (below the line) or 96 or higher (above it). A crossing happens each time the trace moves between 95 and 96 or higher, so I counted the dips down to 95. Each dip produces two crossings, one going down and one coming back up. Moves between 96 and 97 or 98 stay on the same side and don't count.

From the trace, the dips to 95% occur at roughly minutes 19, 39, 43, 55, 69, 86, 116, 127, 143, 150, and 165. That is 11 dips, each contributing two crossings, for 22 crossings in total.

FINAL ANSWER: 22
